newsitems.title: Personal Co-op Gear, Shaker Charges & Fixes
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: Thanks for your feedback and bug reports! Here’s a roundup of the latest improvements since yesterday’s update. New Features & Changes Personal co-op gear: hosts can now choose whether crewmates share equipment or keep their own loadouts. Personal loadouts are saved between sessions, while the crew’s money remains shared. Laser, plasma cutter and missile swarm purchases use solo prices when personal gear is enabled. Five save slots: keep up to five campaigns, with a clearer Load Game menu and automatic selection of an empty slot when starting a new game. Reworked Shaker charges: shake ore loose and pull it toward you, while cracks spread through the surrounding rock. Prices are unchanged. Finer mouse sensitivity: lower the setting to 0.05 and type an exact value directly into the settings field. Reworked telescope: a unified sky view, easier navigation between celestial objects, and improved targeting of the Moon and asteroid. Fixes & General Improvements Fixed co-op bots standing by the lander instead of mining. Improved mouse response after closing menus with Esc. In solo play, time and oxygen pause while mouse control is being restored. Improved tether routes through tunnels and the final approach to the lander. You can now board while still being pulled toward it. Co-op delivery and travel objectives now show the whole crew’s progress and target. Cargo amounts use clearer units, and the last-shift results list every crewmate. Fixed the day getting stuck at 06:59; the next morning now starts automatically. Fixed finds and their rewards remaining after an unfinished shift was rolled back. Improved performance aboard the ship and responsiveness when changing graphics presets. Dirt now washes off in the shower, and its daily bonus is granted once you are clean. Fixed shower water disappearing against the window and objects drawing incorrectly over the workshop screen. Improved several interaction labels and the message shown when co-op players have different game versions. Unruled Games Team

newsitems.title: Stronger Drones, Tunnel Mode & Co-op Fixes
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: Thanks for your feedback and bug reports! Here’s what’s changed since yesterday. Tools & Drones Missile swarm tunnel mode: right-click to switch between spread fire and a focused salvo that digs deeper into the rock. Your selected mode appears on the HUD and is saved between sessions. Stronger explosives: carry 12 standard charges by default and up to 24 with upgrades. Blast-radius upgrades are also more powerful. Stronger, longer-range drones: Digger and Prospector power upgrades now grant 25% per level. The Digger excavates larger areas and independently seeks nearby rock, while the Prospector and Sapper can reach farther. Prospector fix: the drone keeps working when your backpack is full, as long as the ship’s hold has room. Balance Changes Reworked Hard difficulty: new Hard campaigns have roughly 25% less ore, ore income at 90% of normal, and 50% higher ship-gun prices. Existing Hard saves keep their previous rules. Co-op progression: ore sales now pay 90% of their normal value after multiplayer shifts. Laser, plasma cutter and missile swarm prices increase by 50% for two-player crews and 100% for crews of three or more. Solo prices remain unchanged. Fixes & General Improvements Fixed several co-op return issues involving an unconscious host, disconnected players and downed bots, including a launch countdown that could get stuck. Fixed crew objectives failing to receive credit while the host was unconscious. Mining detached rock now also counts toward layer-mining objectives. Teammates’ tether lines are now visible. Tutorial cards can now be dismissed without accidentally using an item. Extended the wash hose from 15 to 25 metres. Compactor tooltips now show your current bonuses alongside the next upgrade. Added a confirmation when returning immediately from a solo landing without mining or collecting cargo. Improved recovery from graphics errors and added more useful performance information to bug reports. Unruled Games Team

newsitems.title: Save Slots, Hard Mode & Co-op Improvements
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: Thanks for all your feedback and bug reports! Here’s what has changed since our November 19 update. New Features Three save slots: keep separate campaigns, with achievements and settings shared between them. Existing saves remain in slot 1. New difficulty: The hard way joins the mode selection, with lower income and reduced bonuses from selected upgrades. By the contract is highlighted as the recommended mode. Find your crew: show teammates’ names, distances and outlines through rock. The default binding is the middle mouse button; it can be changed in Settings, along with how teammates are displayed. More control options: bind actions to the right, middle and side mouse buttons, arrow keys, numpad digits, Enter and Numpad Enter. Existing custom bindings are preserved when new actions are added. General Improvements Co-op fixes: players staying aboard or recovering from a blackout can no longer interrupt the crew’s active shift by launching the lander separately. Upper-deck stairs: fixed a bug that could prevent players from climbing the stairs to the upper deck, especially at high frame rates. Smoother movement: fixed sudden camera flips when flying through the asteroid’s core, and clipping through ceilings or the edges of an excavated landing platform. Clearer mining: the combo now shows an ore icon and multiplier; the misleading cash counter beside the crosshair has been removed. Antimatter is worth more: its base sale price has increased from $56 to $150. Unruled Games Team

newsitems.title: Fixes and Improvements — November 19
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: Thanks for your bug reports! This update includes: • Co-op guests now have their own mining drones, and joining a session causes much shorter freezes. • Fixed invited players being unable to rejoin after being kicked, and the title menu appearing over an active co-op game. • Addressed missing telescope controls after reopening the telescope. • Fixed furniture pushing players through the ship’s walls, and added recovery if a player falls outside the lower deck. • Fixed jumping through the upper deck’s glass dome and getting stuck behind the engine room railing. • Improved tether return paths from deep shafts and pits. • Restored a movable, resizable window when leaving borderless fullscreen. • Fixed movement keys getting stuck after Command shortcuts on Mac and made trackpad scrolling easier to control. • Improved lighting on loose objects when they are turned over. • Improved wording across 27 languages and fixed text clipping in several menus and ship displays. Unruled Games Team

newsitems.title: Keyboard Rebinding & Co-op Fixes
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: Thanks for all your feedback and bug reports! This update includes: Keyboard rebinding: customize your keyboard controls in Settings. On-screen key prompts follow your chosen bindings. Co-op: fixed an issue when hosting after another session ended that could make teammates invisible, prevent them from mining, and stop the new host’s progress from saving. Workshop: removed an invisible obstacle in front of the workbench and fixed clipping into workshop furniture when jumping. Unruled Games Team

newsitems.title: The No Asteroids demo now supports controllers
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: Grab a controller and take a shift on the asteroid. You can swing your pickaxe with the right trigger, then head back to the ship and use the right stick to sell your haul at the trade terminal. Open the gamepad settings to adjust stick sensitivity, invert the vertical look axis, or toggle rumble. We’d love to hear how your first shift feels. Which controller did you use? If a button prompt was confusing or you reached for the mouse, tell us where it happened.

newsitems.title: The No Asteroids demo is out now
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: The free No Asteroids demo is available now! Five million cubic metres of asteroid are heading for Earth. You have a pickaxe, a spaceship, and a job to do. Play the first 15 days: mine the asteroid, sell what you bring back, upgrade your equipment, and explore your ship between shifts. Your save carries over to the full game on the same computer. The demo is available for Windows and Apple Silicon Macs. Download it from the Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527800/No_Asteroids/ The full game launches November 24. Add No Asteroids to your wishlist if you would like to keep going. I would love to hear how your first shifts go. Leave your feedback or report a bug in the Steam discussions — thank you for playing!
